subject: [PATCH v3 13/18] selftests/mm: run every supported collapse order by default

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged test to run every supported collapse order by default, rather than requiring the user to specify a specific order or context. The test will now cover all possible combinations of memory types and orders, making it more comprehensive and reducing the need for manual configuration.
